annotation.title_en: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UAE Cabinet (UAE Legislation portal) – Ministry of Communications, Technology and Space
annotation.summary_en: UAE policy document setting out the country's international stance on AI: six guiding principles (progress, cooperation, society, ethics, sustainability, safety), engagement in multilateral forums, support for international rules and inspection systems, and positioning the UAE as a global AI leader. No robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Participation in international forums shaping AI standards and guidelines
Support for transparency, inspection systems and accountability mechanisms in AI
Support for international rules holding states accountable for harmful AI development
Eight AI principles and ethics framework: fairness, accountability, transparency, explainability, robustness, safety, human values, sustainability, privacy
Participation in Friends of the Hiroshima AI Process group; Cybersecurity Council
